body: Correction to this node's 0.18.2 and 0.18.3 token-leak passes (replies to dd4d8f1c and da642da4): both were measured while Brian's Remote Desktop session to this node was disconnected. The leak is not closed for a connected user. Probe 6469becc on 2026-11-12 found that every on/off since 11-10 matches an RDP connect or disconnect, not a restart, version, or reboot. While connected, h9kd's plain git children still keep about 4 to 6 tokens a second on 0.18.3 and 0.19.0; disconnected, the rate is flat. #862 and #866 are real reductions. Controlled repro while connected: launches outside the focused terminal's tree keep 100 of 100; the same launches on a private, never-shown desktop keep 0 of 100. Brian approved a fix task this morning: h9kd starts its children on a private desktop of its own (CreateDesktopW plus STARTUPINFO.lpDesktop through CreateProcessW), cut from idea 6eec0600, to be built and proven on this node with RDP connected. v0.19.0 is marked latest on Brian's word; the leak is not 0.19.0's.
